messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — elevated 502/504 error rate detected on api-ingress-eu (eu-west-1). 12% 5xx over baseline in the last 3m. Paging current oncall. Degraded customer impact: some GET/POSTs failing with 502s.

alice: saw the alert, jumping in. checking dashboards and edge logs now. @sam can you join? :eyes:

sam: on it. pulling nginx access/error tails and upstream health. any customer reports yet?

maria: I'm watching the load balancer metrics — backend target groups show increased timeout counts, but instance health checks are green. Might be connection resets between edge -> app pool.

charlie: quick note — we rolled a routing config earlier today, but rollout completed hours ago. I don't think it's config, but will verify.

alice: good call. sam, paste the error snippets if you see anything obvious.

sam: here's a quick tail from ingress-eu-nginx-3 (last 60s):
```
2026/03/17 23:45:12 [error] 2345#0: *1023 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.2.3.45, server: api.redwood, request: "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.4.5.12:8080/", host: "api.redwood"
2026/03/17 23:45:13 [error] 2345#0: *1031 upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.2.7.99, server: api.redwood, request: "GET /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.4.5.13:8080/", host: "api.redwood"
```

sam: upstream resets and timeouts. two different app pods returning closed connections. I'm going to scale the app pool and drain the suspected pod.

maria: increasing target group connection timeout temporarily from 30s -> 60s to reduce 504s while we stabilize. pushing change now.

charlie: confirming the routing rollout status — no failures, all backends reported healthy in our config plane.

alice: action list so far: sam scaling app pool + draining suspicious pods, maria bumped LB timeout, charlie verifying config. I'll flip circuit-breaker to prevent cascading retries.

sam: scaled deployment api-service-eu -> +3 replicas, initiating graceful drain on pod api-1234 which shows many 502s in last 1m.

incident-bot: NOTE — automated mitigation suggestion: route 20% of eu traffic to us-west as a fallback. Confirm to apply?

alice: I want to try internal fixes first for 5m, but if errors don't drop below 3% we shift traffic. Sam, keep me posted in 2m.

sam: draining pod done. new pods spinning; health checks passing. currently seeing error rate down to 7% (was 12%). continuing.

maria: LB timeout change applied across eu target groups. observing a drop in 504s, 502s still present but trending down.

charlie: I see an increase in TCP RSTs between edge proxies and backend on one AZ (eu-west-1b). I'm leaning toward overloaded app threadpool/worker exhaustion under a slightly different request mix.

alice: could be a memory GC pressure or sudden request size spike. sam, are there any anomalous request patterns?

sam: scanning logs for large payloads... a handful of unusually large POSTs ~2.9MB but not enough volume to explain. CPU spikes on two pods around 23:44 — adding vertical headroom is slower; prefer to keep scaling horizontally.

alice: ok. continue scale and circuit-breaker. If it stays >5% for another 3m, we will enable the fallback routing.

sam: error rate now 3.1% (1.5m after mitigation). slow but moving. I'll keep draining any pod with >1% 5xx and let autoscaler stabilize.

maria: telemetry shows customer-impacted endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. added annotation to incident tracker and pinged support to notify customers on status page.

charlie: added short-term rate limit on raw batch endpoints to reduce backend pressure (500 QPS -> 200 QPS) to buy time.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0317-89. Severity: P2. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0317-89

alice: brief status for handoff: 5xx peaked at 12%, now 3% after scaling, LB timeout increased, one bad pod drained, temporary rate limit and circuit-breaker applied. No widespread data loss. Support contacted, incident created.

ben: taking over for the midnight block. thanks team. I'll monitor for 30m and coordinate follow-ups in the morning. can someone add a short runbook note about which pods were drained and the exact LB timeout change?

sam: added notes to incident: drained pod api-1234, api-1256; scaled +3 replicas; autoscaler events at 23:46.

maria: LB idle timeout changed from 30s -> 60s at 23:46:22 UTC. added to incident notes.

alice: handing off to ben. if error rate creeps back up >5% re-escalate and execute cross-region shift (incident-bot suggestion).

ben: acknowledged. will keep the fallback plan ready and will reopen ops channel if needed. :thumbsup:
